provenance: Source-authored task labels frozen before compact retrieval implementation/results. Expectations reference immutable successor source gold, not extracted output.

tasks.prompt: Show recorded producers and consumers of RegistrationSubmitted and its contract declaration, with source evidence. State remaining wrapper/saga gaps.

paired_protocol.snapshot: Both arms use the exact same published immutable snapshot/artifact.
paired_protocol.context_selection: Resolve exact Debug/net8.0 project context IDs before timed task execution. Run each retained Components variant separately, never merge incompatible same-project alternatives. Record every explicit selected ID; use identical selections in both arms.
paired_protocol.baseline: One compiler_contract_impact call plus compiler_definitions for each selected context, querying the same exact contract ID.
paired_protocol.candidate: One compiler_contract_context call using the same exact contract ID and explicit contexts.
paired_protocol.discovery: Measure context-discovery calls/bytes separately and identically; report definition-only context choices. Discovery cannot silently select a context.
paired_protocol.bytes: Sum actual serialized complete MCP tool return bytes using identical encoder for both arms, including structuredContent/text duplication if present. Also report structuredContent bytes separately; do not substitute index materialization budgets.
paired_protocol.tool_calls: Count every attempted tool invocation, including discovery separately, errors and retries. No hidden free calls.
paired_protocol.evidence_equivalence: Normalize both responses to exact contract, context ID, source snapshot/occurrence identity, path/raw hash/token span, kind/rule/scope, ordered target roles/full symbol keys, lifetime/table/schema, and actual recorded owner. Require tuple equality and source-gold expected evidence completeness.
paired_protocol.definitions: Require exact source-authored definition path/hash/token span and contract identity per selected definition context. Missing definitions cannot be hidden by evidence-only context discovery.
paired_protocol.failure: Any missing expected evidence/definition, extra unsupported assertion, truncation, provenance mismatch, context omission or budget overflow fails semantic acceptance; report partial measurements honestly.
paired_protocol.quality: Evidence/definition acceptance is required independently of byte/call savings. Known unsupported gaps remain explicit limitations. Do not claim runtime delivery, activation, database behavior, or interprocedural wrapper completeness.
paired_protocol.comparison: Paired internal interface evaluation only. No CodeGraph competitiveness claim without an actual same-input, same-task external run.
